function esl_buffer_Open(filename::Union{Nothing, String}, env::Union{Nothing, String})
    bf = ESL_BUFFER(nothing, 0, nothing, 0, nothing, 0, 0, 4096, nothing, nothing, -1, false, false, false, false, eslBUFFER_UNSET)
    if filename === nothing
        bf.fp = stdin
        bf.do_stdin = true
        bf.filename = nothing
        bf.mode_is = eslBUFFER_STREAM
    else
        if endswith(filename, ".gz")
            bf.do_gzip = true
            bf.fp = open(`gunzip -c $filename`)
            bf.filename = filename
            bf.mode_is = eslBUFFER_CMDPIPE
        else
            bf.fp = open(filename, "r")
            bf.filename = filename
            bf.mode_is = eslBUFFER_FILE
        end
    end
    bf.allocsize = bf.pagesize * 256
    bf.balloc = bf.allocsize
    bf.mem = Vector{UInt8}(undef, bf.balloc)
    bf.n = 0
    bf.baseoffset = 0
    bf.anchor = nothing
    bf.pos = nothing
    return bf
end

function esl_buffer_Close(bf::ESL_BUFFER)
    if bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_FILE || bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_CMDPIPE
        if bf.fp !== nothing && bf.do_stdin == false
            close(bf.fp)
        end
    end
    if bf.do_buffer && bf.mem !== nothing
        bf.mem = nothing
    end
    return nothing
end

function esl_buffer_Set(bf::ESL_BUFFER, anchor::Union{Nothing, Ptr{UInt8}}, offset::Int64)
    if anchor === nothing
        bf.pos = nothing
        return eslOK
    end
    nbase = bf.baseoffset
    if bf.mem !== nothing && nbase <= offset && offset < nbase + bf.n
        bf.pos = pointer(bf.mem, offset - nbase + 1)
        return eslOK
    end
    return eslFAIL
end

function esl_buffer_SetOffset(bf::ESL_BUFFER, offset::Int64)
    if bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_STRING || bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_MMAP
        if offset >= 0 && offset < bf.balloc
            bf.pos = pointer(bf.mem, offset + 1)
            bf.baseoffset = 0
            bf.n = bf.balloc
            return eslOK
        end
        return eslFAIL
    end
    if bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_STREAM || bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_CMDPIPE
        return eslFAIL
    end
    if bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_FILE
        if bf.fp !== nothing
            seekstart(bf.fp)
            skip(bf.fp, offset)
            bf.baseoffset = offset
            bf.n = 0
            bf.pos = nothing
            bf.anchor = nothing
            return eslOK
        end
    end
    return eslFAIL
end

function esl_buffer_GetOffset(bf::ESL_BUFFER)

function esl_buffer_RaiseAnchor(bf::ESL_BUFFER, new_anchor::Ptr{UInt8})
    if new_anchor === nothing
        bf.anchor = nothing
        return eslOK

    if bf.mem === nothing

    anchor_offset = new_anchor - pointer(bf.mem)

    bf.anchor = new_anchor

function esl_buffer_Get(bf::ESL_BUFFER)
    if bf.pos === nothing
        return (nothing, 0)

    p_offset = bf.pos - pointer(bf.mem)
    if p_offset >= bf.n
        return (nothing, 0)
    end
    return (bf.pos, bf.n - p_offset)

function esl_buffer_GetLine(bf::ESL_BUFFER)
    while true
        if bf.pos === nothing
            if bf.n == 0 && (bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_STRING || bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_MMAP)
                return (eslEOF, nothing, 0)
            end
            status = esl_buffer_Read(bf)
            if status == eslEOF
                return (eslEOF, nothing, 0)
            elseif status != eslOK
                return (status, nothing, 0)
            end
        end
        
        p_offset = bf.pos - pointer(bf.mem)
        remaining = bf.n - p_offset
        
        newline_pos = findfirst(==(UInt8('\n')), view(bf.mem, p_offset+1:bf.n))
        
        if newline_pos !== nothing
            line_length = newline_pos
            result_ptr = bf.pos
            bf.pos = pointer(bf.mem, p_offset + line_length + 1)
            return (eslOK, result_ptr, line_length - 1)
        else
            if bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_STRING || bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_MMAP
                result_ptr = bf.pos
                result_len = remaining
                bf.pos = pointer(bf.mem, bf.n + 1)
                return (eslOK, result_ptr, result_len)
            else
                status = esl_buffer_Read(bf)
                if status == eslEOF
                    if remaining > 0
                        result_ptr = bf.pos
                        bf.pos = pointer(bf.mem, bf.n + 1)
                        return (eslOK, result_ptr, remaining)
                    else
                        return (eslEOF, nothing, 0)
                    end
                elseif status != eslOK

                end
            end
        end
    end

function esl_buffer_GetToken(bf::ESL_BUFFER, sep::String)
    while true
        if bf.pos === nothing
            if bf.n == 0 && (bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_STRING || bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_MMAP)

            status = esl_buffer_Read(bf)

                return (status, nothing, 0)

        p_offset = bf.pos - pointer(bf.mem)
        remaining = bf.n - p_offset
        
        sep_bytes = Vector{UInt8}(sep)
        token_end = nothing
        
        for i in 1:remaining
            if bf.mem[p_offset + i] in sep_bytes
                token_end = i
                break
            end
        end
        
        if token_end !== nothing
            result_ptr = bf.pos
            result_len = token_end - 1
            bf.pos = pointer(bf.mem, p_offset + token_end + 1)
            return (eslOK, result_ptr, result_len)
        else

function esl_buffer_Read(bf::ESL_BUFFER)
    if bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_STRING || bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_MMAP
        return eslEOF
    end
    
    if bf.anchor !== nothing
        anchor_offset = bf.anchor - pointer(bf.mem)
        space_needed = bf.n - anchor_offset + bf.allocsize
        
        if space_needed > bf.balloc
            new_balloc = space_needed
            new_mem = Vector{UInt8}(undef, new_balloc)
            copyto!(new_mem, 1, bf.mem, anchor_offset + 1, bf.n - anchor_offset)
            bf.mem = new_mem
            bf.balloc = new_balloc
            bf.baseoffset += anchor_offset
            bf.n -= anchor_offset
            bf.pos = bf.pos === nothing ? nothing : pointer(bf.mem, (bf.pos - bf.anchor) + 1)
            bf.anchor = pointer(bf.mem)
        else
            copyto!(bf.mem, 1, bf.mem, anchor_offset + 1, bf.n - anchor_offset)
            bf.baseoffset += anchor_offset
            bf.n -= anchor_offset
            bf.pos = bf.pos === nothing ? nothing : pointer(bf.mem, (bf.pos - bf.anchor) + 1)
            bf.anchor = pointer(bf.mem)
        end
    else
        bf.baseoffset += bf.n
        bf.n = 0
        if bf.pos !== nothing
            bf.pos = pointer(bf.mem)
        end
    end
    
    space_available = bf.balloc - bf.n
    bytes_to_read = min(space_available, bf.allocsize)
    
    if bytes_to_read == 0
        return eslEMEM
    end
    
    if bf.fp !== nothing
        try
            nread = readbytes!(bf.fp, view(bf.mem, bf.n+1:bf.n+bytes_to_read), bytes_to_read)
            if nread == 0
                return eslEOF
            end
            bf.n += nread
            if bf.pos === nothing
                bf.pos = pointer(bf.mem)
            end
            return eslOK
        catch
            return eslEOF
        end
    end
    
    return eslEOF
end

using Printf

mutable struct ESL_BUFFER
    mem::Union{Nothing, Vector{UInt8}}
    balloc::Int64
    anchor::Union{Nothing, Int64}
    baseoffset::Int64
    pos::Union{Nothing, Int64}
    n::Int64
    allocsize::Int64

    do_gzip::Bool
    do_stdin::Bool
    do_buffer::Bool
    mode_is::Int32
end

const eslBUFFER_UNSET = Int32(0)
const eslBUFFER_STREAM = Int32(1)
const eslBUFFER_FILE = Int32(2)
const eslBUFFER_STRING = Int32(3)
const eslBUFFER_MMAP = Int32(4)
const eslBUFFER_CMDPIPE = Int32(5)
const eslOK = Int32(0)
const eslFAIL = Int32(1)
const eslEOF = Int32(2)
const eslEOD = Int32(3)
const eslEMEM = Int32(4)
const eslENOTFOUND = Int32(5)
const eslEFORMAT = Int32(6)
const eslEAMBIGUOUS = Int32(7)
const eslEDIVZERO = Int32(8)
const eslEINCOMPAT = Int32(9)
const eslEINVAL = Int32(10)
const eslESYS = Int32(11)
const eslECORRUPT = Int32(12)
const eslEINCONCEIVABLE = Int32(13)
const eslESYNTAX = Int32(14)
const eslERANGE = Int32(15)

const eslENOHALT = Int32(22)
const eslENOTIMPLEMENTED = Int32(23)

function buffer_create(mode_is::Int32)::ESL_BUFFER
    bf = ESL_BUFFER(nothing, Int64(0), nothing, Int64(0), nothing, Int64(0), Int64(0), Int64(4096), nothing, nothing, Int32(-1), false, false, false, false, eslBUFFER_UNSET)
    bf.mode_is = mode_is
    bf.pagesize = Int64(4096)
    bf.allocsize = bf.pagesize * Int64(256)
    bf.balloc = Int64(0)
    bf.mem = nothing
    bf.n = Int64(0)
    bf.baseoffset = Int64(0)
    bf.anchor = nothing
    bf.pos = nothing
    bf.fp = nothing
    bf.filename = nothing
    bf.fd = Int32(-1)
    bf.do_mmap = false
    bf.do_gzip = false
    bf.do_stdin = false
    bf.do_buffer = false
    return bf
end

function buffer_init_for_loading(bf::ESL_BUFFER)::Int32
    bf.balloc = bf.allocsize
    bf.mem = Vector{UInt8}(undef, bf.balloc)
    bf.n = Int64(0)
    bf.baseoffset = Int64(0)
    bf.anchor = nothing
    bf.pos = nothing
    return eslOK
end

function buffer_refill(bf::ESL_BUFFER, nmin::Int64)::Int32
    if bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_STRING || bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_MMAP
        return eslEOF
    end
    
    if bf.anchor !== nothing
        anchor_offset = bf.anchor
        bytes_to_keep = bf.n - anchor_offset
        space_needed = bytes_to_keep + nmin
        
        if space_needed > bf.balloc
            new_balloc = max(space_needed, bf.balloc * Int64(2))
            new_mem = Vector{UInt8}(undef, new_balloc)
            if bytes_to_keep > 0
                copyto!(new_mem, 1, bf.mem, anchor_offset + 1, bytes_to_keep)
            end
            bf.mem = new_mem
            bf.balloc = new_balloc
        else
            if bytes_to_keep > 0
                copyto!(bf.mem, 1, bf.mem, anchor_offset + 1, bytes_to_keep)
            end
        end
        
        bf.baseoffset += anchor_offset
        bf.n = bytes_to_keep
        
        if bf.pos !== nothing
            bf.pos = bf.pos - anchor_offset
        end
        bf.anchor = Int64(0)
    else
        bf.baseoffset += bf.n
        bf.n = Int64(0)
        bf.pos = nothing
    end
    
    space_available = bf.balloc - bf.n
    bytes_to_read = min(space_available, bf.allocsize)
    
    if bytes_to_read < nmin
        new_balloc = bf.n + nmin
        new_mem = Vector{UInt8}(undef, new_balloc)
        if bf.n > 0
            copyto!(new_mem, 1, bf.mem, 1, bf.n)
        end
        bf.mem = new_mem
        bf.balloc = new_balloc
        bytes_to_read = nmin
    end
    
    if bf.fp !== nothing
        try
            nread = readbytes!(bf.fp, view(bf.mem, bf.n+1:bf.n+bytes_to_read), bytes_to_read)
            if nread == 0
                return eslEOF
            end
            bf.n += nread
            if bf.pos === nothing
                bf.pos = Int64(0)
            end
            return eslOK
        catch
            return eslEOF
        end
    end
    
    return eslEOF
end

function esl_buffer_Open(filename::Union{Nothing, String}, env::Union{Nothing, String})::Union{Nothing, ESL_BUFFER}
    bf = buffer_create(eslBUFFER_UNSET)
    
    if filename === nothing
        bf.fp = stdin
        bf.do_stdin = true
        bf.filename = nothing
        bf.mode_is = eslBUFFER_STREAM
    else
        if endswith(filename, ".gz")
            bf.do_gzip = true
            try
                bf.fp = open(pipeline(`gunzip -c $filename`), "r")
                bf.filename = filename
                bf.mode_is = eslBUFFER_CMDPIPE
            catch
                return nothing
            end
        else
            try
                bf.fp = open(filename, "r")
                bf.filename = filename
                bf.mode_is = eslBUFFER_FILE
            catch
                return nothing
            end
        end
    end
    
    buffer_init_for_loading(bf)
    return bf
end

function esl_buffer_OpenFile(filename::String)::Union{Nothing, ESL_BUFFER}
    bf = buffer_create(eslBUFFER_FILE)
    
    try
        bf.fp = open(filename, "r")
        bf.filename = filename
    catch
        return nothing
    end
    
    buffer_init_for_loading(bf)
    return bf
end

function esl_buffer_OpenPipe(env::Union{Nothing, String}, cmdfmt::String, args...)::Union{Nothing, ESL_BUFFER}
    bf = buffer_create(eslBUFFER_CMDPIPE)
    
    cmd = @sprintf(cmdfmt, args...)
    
    try
        bf.fp = open(pipeline(`sh -c $cmd`), "r")
        bf.filename = cmd
    catch
        return nothing
    end
    
    buffer_init_for_loading(bf)
    return bf
end

function esl_buffer_OpenMem(p::Vector{UInt8}, n::Int64)::ESL_BUFFER
    bf = buffer_create(eslBUFFER_STRING)
    bf.mem = p
    bf.balloc = n
    bf.n = n
    bf.baseoffset = Int64(0)
    bf.anchor = nothing
    bf.pos = Int64(0)
    bf.fp = nothing
    bf.filename = nothing
    return bf
end

function esl_buffer_OpenStream(fp::IO)::ESL_BUFFER
    bf = buffer_create(eslBUFFER_STREAM)
    bf.fp = fp
    bf.filename = nothing
    buffer_init_for_loading(bf)
    return bf
end

function esl_buffer_Close(bf::ESL_BUFFER)
    if bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_FILE || bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_CMDPIPE
        if bf.fp !== nothing && bf.do_stdin == false
            close(bf.fp)
            bf.fp = nothing
        end
    end
    
    if bf.do_buffer && bf.mem !== nothing
        bf.mem = nothing
    end
    
    return nothing
end

function esl_buffer_Set(bf::ESL_BUFFER, anchor::Union{Nothing, Int64}, offset::Int64)::Int32
    if anchor === nothing
        bf.pos = nothing
        return eslOK
    end
    
    nbase = bf.baseoffset
    
    if bf.mem !== nothing && nbase <= offset && offset < nbase + bf.n
        bf.pos = offset - nbase
        return eslOK
    end
    
    return eslFAIL
end

function esl_buffer_SetOffset(bf::ESL_BUFFER, offset::Int64)::Int32
    if bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_STRING || bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_MMAP
        if offset >= 0 && offset < bf.balloc
            bf.pos = offset
            bf.baseoffset = Int64(0)
            bf.n = bf.balloc
            return eslOK
        end
        return eslFAIL
    end
    
    if bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_STREAM || bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_CMDPIPE
        return eslFAIL
    end
    
    if bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_FILE
        if bf.fp !== nothing
            try
                seekstart(bf.fp)
                skip(bf.fp, offset)
                bf.baseoffset = offset
                bf.n = Int64(0)
                bf.pos = nothing
                bf.anchor = nothing
                return eslOK
            catch
                return eslFAIL
            end
        end
    end
    
    return eslFAIL
end

function esl_buffer_SetStdin(bf::ESL_BUFFER)::Int32
    if bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_UNSET
        bf.fp = stdin
        bf.do_stdin = true
        bf.mode_is = eslBUFFER_STREAM
        bf.filename = nothing
        buffer_init_for_loading(bf)
        return eslOK
    end
    return eslFAIL
end

function esl_buffer_SetString(bf::ESL_BUFFER, s::String)::Int32
    if bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_UNSET
        bf.mem = Vector{UInt8}(s)
        bf.balloc = Int64(length(s))
        bf.n = Int64(length(s))
        bf.baseoffset = Int64(0)
        bf.anchor = nothing
        bf.pos = Int64(0)
        bf.mode_is = eslBUFFER_STRING
        bf.fp = nothing
        bf.filename = nothing
        return eslOK
    end
    return eslFAIL
end

function esl_buffer_GetOffset(bf::ESL_BUFFER)::Int64
    if bf.pos === nothing
        return bf.baseoffset + bf.n
    else
        return bf.baseoffset + bf.pos
    end
end

function esl_buffer_GetAnchor(bf::ESL_BUFFER)::Int64
    if bf.anchor === nothing
        return Int64(0)
    else
        return bf.baseoffset + bf.anchor
    end
end

function esl_buffer_RaiseAnchor(bf::ESL_BUFFER, new_anchor::Union{Nothing, Int64})::Int32
    if new_anchor === nothing
        bf.anchor = nothing
        return eslOK
    end
    
    if bf.mem === nothing
        return eslFAIL
    end
    
    anchor_offset = new_anchor - bf.baseoffset
    
    if anchor_offset < 0 || anchor_offset >= bf.n
        return eslEINVAL
    end
    
    bf.anchor = anchor_offset
    return eslOK
end

function esl_buffer_Get(bf::ESL_BUFFER)::Tuple{Int32, Union{Nothing, Int64}, Int64}
    if bf.pos === nothing
        return (eslEOD, nothing, Int64(0))
    end
    
    if bf.pos >= bf.n
        return (eslEOD, nothing, Int64(0))
    end
    
    ret_offset = bf.baseoffset + bf.pos
    ret_n = bf.n - bf.pos
    
    return (eslOK, ret_offset, ret_n)
end

function esl_buffer_GetLine(bf::ESL_BUFFER)::Tuple{Int32, Union{Nothing, Int64}, Int64}
    while true
        if bf.pos === nothing || bf.pos >= bf.n
            if bf.n == 0 && (bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_STRING || bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_MMAP)
                return (eslEOF, nothing, Int64(0))
            end
            
            status = buffer_refill(bf, bf.allocsize)
            if status == eslEOF
                return (eslEOF, nothing, Int64(0))
            elseif status != eslOK
                return (status, nothing, Int64(0))
            end
        end
        
        if bf.pos === nothing
            bf.pos = Int64(0)
        end
        
        remaining = bf.n - bf.pos
        newline_idx = nothing
        
        for i in 1:remaining
            if bf.mem[bf.pos + i] == UInt8('\n')
                newline_idx = i
                break
            end
        end
        
        if newline_idx !== nothing
            result_offset = bf.baseoffset + bf.pos
            result_len = newline_idx - 1
            bf.pos += newline_idx
            return (eslOK, result_offset, result_len)
        else
            if bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_STRING || bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_MMAP
                result_offset = bf.baseoffset + bf.pos
                result_len = remaining
                bf.pos = bf.n
                return (eslOK, result_offset, result_len)
            else
                status = buffer_refill(bf, bf.allocsize)
                if status == eslEOF
                    if remaining > 0
                        result_offset = bf.baseoffset + bf.pos
                        result_len = remaining
                        bf.pos = bf.n
                        return (eslOK, result_offset, result_len)
                    else
                        return (eslEOF, nothing, Int64(0))
                    end
                elseif status != eslOK
                    return (status, nothing, Int64(0))
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function esl_buffer_GetToken(bf::ESL_BUFFER, sep::String)::Tuple{Int32, Union{Nothing, Int64}, Int64}
    sep_bytes = Set{UInt8}(Vector{UInt8}(sep))
    
    while true
        if bf.pos === nothing || bf.pos >= bf.n
            if bf.n == 0 && (bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_STRING || bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_MMAP)
                return (eslEOF, nothing, Int64(0))
            end
            
            status = buffer_refill(bf, bf.allocsize)
            if status == eslEOF
                return (eslEOF, nothing, Int64(0))
            elseif status != eslOK
                return (status, nothing, Int64(0))
            end
        end
        
        if bf.pos === nothing
            bf.pos = Int64(0)
        end
        
        while bf.pos < bf.n && bf.mem[bf.pos + 1] in sep_bytes
            bf.pos += 1
        end
        
        if bf.pos >= bf.n
            continue
        end
        
        tok_start = bf.pos
        remaining = bf.n - bf.pos
        sep_idx = nothing
        
        for i in 1:remaining
            if bf.mem[bf.pos + i] in sep_bytes
                sep_idx = i
                break
            end
        end
        
        if sep_idx !== nothing
            result_offset = bf.baseoffset + tok_start
            result_len = sep_idx - 1
            bf.pos = tok_start + sep_idx
            return (eslOK, result_offset, result_len)
        else
            if bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_STRING || bf.mode_is == eslBUFFER_MMAP
                if remaining > 0
                    result_offset = bf.baseoffset + tok_start
                    result_len = remaining
                    bf.pos = bf.n
                    return (eslOK, result_offset, result_len)
                else
                    return (eslEOF, nothing, Int64(0))
                end
            else
                status = buffer_refill(bf, bf.allocsize)
                if status == eslEOF
                    if remaining > 0
                        result_offset = bf.baseoffset + tok_start
                        result_len = remaining
                        bf.pos = bf.n
                        return (eslOK, result_offset, result_len)
                    else
                        return (eslEOF, nothing, Int64(0))
                    end
                elseif status != eslOK
                    return (status, nothing, Int64(0))
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function esl_buffer_FetchLine(bf::ESL_BUFFER)::Tuple{Int32, Union{Nothing, String}}
    status, offset, len = esl_buffer_GetLine(bf)
    if status == eslOK && offset !== nothing
        start_idx = offset - bf.baseoffset + 1
        line_bytes = bf.mem[start_idx:start_idx+len-1]
        return (eslOK, String(copy(line_bytes)))
    else
        return (status, nothing)
    end
end

    status, offset, len = esl_buffer_GetLine(bf)

function esl_buffer_Read(bf::ESL_BUFFER)::Int32

function esl_buffer_Slurp(bf::ESL_BUFFER)::Int32
